thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: GPU capacity alarm triggered for us-west-2-prod (queue growth > 800 reqs). Escalation policy applied. oncall: @alex_oncall

maria.chen: seeing steady queue backlog for the ml-serving cluster, pods Pending for > 6m. autoscaler logs show scaling attempts but no new GPU nodes attach.

sam.patel: can you paste the autoscaler errors?

maria.chen: sure, tail from the autoscaler:```ERROR: failed to launch nodegroup: InvalidLaunchTemplate: LaunchTemplateId 'lt-0abc123' does not exist
Caused by: AttachRole failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole```

ricardo.gomez: oof, looks like launch template drift plus iam passrole is failing. we've seen policies rotated in the last config rollout.

ashley.nguyen: confirming: this is affecting hosted realtime customers hitting generate endpoints in us-west-2. latency spike and 429s reported.

alex_oncall: marking customer impact = high. start mitigation runbook 3.1 (manual node attach + fallback). @support-robin open incident severity page and notify affected accounts.

support-robin: creating incident page, pinging top 5 customers that hit our SLA. adding note: temporary retries and rate limits applied to reduce queue.

maria.chen: quick actions I'm taking: 1) attempt manual ASG instance launch with correct launch-template-id, 2) temp remove taint enforcement on gpu pools to allow best-effort scheduling, 3) ramping down noncritical batch jobs.

sam.patel: if it's iam:PassRole, check the instance profile role ARN in the LT vs current role. Maybe the role was renamed in the infra rollout.

maria.chen: confirm: LT references role arn:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/old-gpu-node-role, current role is role/gpu-node-role-v2. autoscaler rejects attach due to PassRole mismatch.

ricardo.gomez: ok, two parallel mitigations: A) temporary create a compatible launch template referencing gpu-node-role-v2 and update ASG, B) manual scale-up of a prebuilt GPU ASG using a working template (sanity checked). Which one is faster?

maria.chen: B is fastest for immediate capacity. I'll kick off manual ASG create now.

infra-bot: <deploy-bot> initiated ASG creation in us-west-2: group gpu-emergency-6076, desired=8, instanceType=p4d. Estimated boot time ~4-6m.

sam.patel: also adding a temporary cluster-autoscaler flag to ignore taints: --skip-taints-check=true (will open followup to revert).

ashley.nguyen: we've applied a soft rate limit to non-enterprise customers and increased retry-backoff for SDKs. Observed error rate for critical tenants reduced by ~40% so far.

maria.chen: new nodes coming up, kubelet join logs show: "Registered node gpu-6076-1", but then kube-proxy reports: "pod eviction due to taint: gpu-only" — removing taint now.

alex_oncall: check app-level fallback — are we failing over requests to cpu-backed fallback model?

sam.patel: yes, traffic router has a fallback policy for model variants. We flipped route for low-priority routes at 6076543450. Critical customers kept on GPU route while we restore capacity.

support-robin: emailing affected customers with ETA ~20m, note: mitigation in progress, minimal data exposure.

maria.chen: autoscaler still logs some failures referencing LaunchTemplateVersion '7' but ASG now references new LT id. I think there's a race: older controller ops trying to use stale LT id cached in a controller pod. Restarting controller.

ricardo.gomez: restart done. controller restarted (kubectl rollout restart deployment/cluster-autoscaler). watching logs.

infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler logs show new attempt: "CreateNodeGroup succeeded: gpu-emergency-6076"

maria.chen: nodes are Ready. scheduling backlog draining. queue size dropping from 870 -> 260 in last 6m.

alex_oncall: great work. next: 1) patch the launch template in infra repo to reference current role and new image, 2) open infra change to rotate role permissions with audit, 3) revert skip-taints flag after stabilization.

sam.patel: I'll file the infra PR and assign to infra team. dropping in the runbook checklist with links.

ashley.nguyen: support status: ticket #INC-6076 created, customers notified, monitoring dashboards updated to show recovery. Ops working on postmortem.

maria.chen: final note: root cause = role rename + rollout that didn't update dependent LT references; symptom = autoscaler unable to attach nodes -> gly queue growth + throttling. Mitigation = manual ASG create with working template + controller restart + temporary scheduling relax.

alex_oncall: handing off to @sam.patel for postmortem and followups. I'll stay on-call until recovery verified and hand over in 30m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident acknowledged as RESOLVED_PROVISIONAL at 6076543870. Please file postmortem within 48h and tag with severity:sev-2 and "launch-template-drift".
